items.lede: Citrix has released emergency updates for a new NetScaler denial-of-service vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-88779 that has been exploited in zero-day attacks, with researchers investigating whether it can also be exploited for remote code execution. [...]
items.title: Citrix patches NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in attacks

items.lede: The new vuln, CVE-2026-88779, is a memory overflow bug that leads to denial of service
items.title: Citrix NetScaler security snafus get even worse amid more 0-day reports
